test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: City A is located to the North of city B. City D is located to the East of city B. City C is located to the West of city D. City É is located to the South of city C and to the South-West of city A. What is the position of city B with respect to city C?
solution: **Explanation:** From the given information: Step 1: City A is located to the North of city B. City D is located to the East of city B.
